independent_correction.issue: The preexisting table5 SOURCE PASS establishes reported human recognition and inferred directional photopic background. But the methods/Q&A explicitly document optical magnification in the observing apparatus; the star-by-star record does not distinguish naked-eye from 7x50 sextant-monocular recognition.
independent_correction.contaminated_claim_to_avoid: Do not count four stars as confirmed unaided-eye first sighting cases, compute model timing errors, or promote [2,10.5] or (10.5,16] support.
independent_correction.required_original_resolution: Contemporaneous ship observing log or author method clarification showing for each object whether telescope/7x50 was used; plus independently timestamped last-NO/first-YES and site/time/atmosphere/adaptation to qualify first-time comparisons.

user_notification_threshold: Material provenance/methodological correction; no claimed new star outcome.
